text: Said Pur Temple Complex Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Said Pur Temple Complex Type: Monument - Temple Province: Islamabad District: Islamabad Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1799-1849 CE Description: It is a temple located at the feet of Margalla Hills in Islamabad. The complex is comprised of two temples and Dharamshala. The complex has been constructed in standard size bricks. Main temple, located on western half is square in plan and superimposed with a bulbous dome erected on an octagonal and circular drum with a finial on the top. The sanctum of the temple on the north, south and western side is divided into three rows of sunken panels on the outer surface.
